summary: Phase 3 features fully tested: Family Health Vault, Bulk Inventory Import, 3D Organ Viewer. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for Organ Viewer (12 organs with tests/conditions), Family Health Vault (CRUD records), and My Cura page (Health Tools grid with Body Map and Voice Book).

Family vault CRUD operations work correctly with proper categorization (allergies, conditions, medications)
Bulk CSV import handles edge cases (empty rows, non-CSV files) gracefully
Inventory stats aggregation working with category grouping
All data-testid attributes present for testing
